interpretations.prerequisite_or_policy: The declared policy defines allowed and denied source/service pairs for a specific service, and the effective rule-set revision, enforcement interface, rule ordering and state handling at the enforcement point are established before interpretation. interpretations.legitimate_outcome: Allowed connectivity from a policy-allowed peer to the protected service is legitimate when the control confirms the service is reachable and the identity mapping and path are verified.
interpretations.suspected_violation: Enforcement failure is suspected only when an independently established denied identity reaches the protected service under the stated policy with identity mapping and path verified; mere response differences or successful connectivity from an unspecified peer do not establish a violation.
interpretations.distinguishing_control: Establish an allowed-peer baseline using a fresh connection, then attempt the same operation from the independently verified denied peer holding service, protocol and operation constant, with pre-existing connection state accounted for, and repeat the allowed control to confirm service availability remains unchanged. Record which rule and state decision applied when available, and preserve policy reference, rule-set revision, state considerations, source identity mapping, destination/service identity, connection attempts, timestamps and service-side observations.
